description: Add comprehensive documentation for the FastAPI VS Code extension to the official documentation site. This should include a dedicated section explaining the extension's features and benefits, plus integration into the existing tutorial structure to help users discover and utilize this development tool.
functional_requirements: Create a new documentation section dedicated to editor and IDE support, with a primary focus on the VS Code extension.
Within the new section, document the key features of the extension (e.g., autocompletion, debugging, navigation) and provide basic setup/usage instructions.
Add a reference or link to this new 'Editor Support' section from the main tutorial index page to ensure visibility for new users.
